$comment: Contract for data/tables/page_context.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; applied by build/src/compile.js (D116).
title: Page context
description: What a source page states once for the values printed on it: a heading such as "Mechanical properties (dry state)" or "printed, non-injection moulded specimens", a footnote such as "all specimens annealed at 80 °C for 12 h", a block standard or a test temperature. A measurement on that page whose own row states nothing for a field inherits it; a row that states the opposite is flagged (CONTEXT-ROW-CONTRADICTS-PAGE). One row per page and scope; a page no row names states nothing (D116).

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: The source whose page states it.

fields.name: Page
fields.description: The page, as measurements' locators number it ("p. 2").

fields.name: Applies to
fields.description: Which of the page's values the statement covers.

fields.name: Specimen type
fields.description: The specimen form the page states, or Not published.

fields.name: Moisture state
fields.description: dry, conditioned, or not-stated where the page says nothing about moisture.

fields.name: Post-processing state
fields.description: as-printed, annealed, or not-stated where the page says nothing about treatment.

fields.name: Anneal °C
fields.description: The annealing temperature the page states. Not published: annealed, temperature not stated. Not applicable: not annealed.

fields.name: Anneal h
fields.description: The annealing time in hours the page states, with the same missing states as Anneal °C.

fields.name: Standard
fields.description: The standard the page prints once for these rows, at family level (ISO 527, ASTM D638), or Not published.

fields.name: Test temperature °C
fields.description: The test temperature the page states for these rows, or Not published.

fields.name: Locator
fields.description: Where on the page: the heading, footnote or line quoted.

fields.name: Reviewed by
fields.description: Who read the page, and when: a person, or an agent named as one.
